name: Greenhouse jobs to CSV — manual capped export

nodes.name: Manual start
nodes.notes: Importing does not run the Actor. Each manual execution starts a new paid snapshot.

nodes.name: Get Greenhouse jobs — max $0.02
nodes.notes: Select a private Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN. No token or credential ID is included. Edit boardTokens and filters in the JSON body. One execution starts a paid snapshot; no automatic retry. If a response is lost, check the existing run in Apify Console before another POST.

nodes.name: Create jobs.csv
nodes.notes: Download binary field data after execution. Columns match the Python jobs exporter. Empty datasets may produce no CSV file. Formula-like cells receive an apostrophe prefix; preserve the original JSON for unmodified strings.
